reasoning: RC01 indicates the bank identifier (BIC) was rejected by the intermediary, which usually means the BIC supplied is wrong. The rest of the details (amount, account number) are valid, so a one‑off data‑entry error is most likely.
recommended_action: Ask the client to confirm the beneficiary bank's SWIFT code (NKYSNOBBXXX) and correct any typo, then resubmit the payment.
